	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = hd_hb_d_an_qi } }
		house:uuii_book_house_b2517ba4d70c ?= { save_scope_as = hd_hb_house }
		hd_hb_spawn_effect = { ID = an_qi }
		scope:hd_hb_person ?= {
			set_global_variable = { name = hd_hb_d_an_qi value = yes }
		}
		hd_hb_clear_effect = yes
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = hd_hb_d_ren } }
		house:uuii_book_house_787d74405692 ?= { save_scope_as = hd_hb_house }
		hd_hb_spawn_effect = { ID = ren }
		scope:hd_hb_person ?= {
			set_global_variable = { name = hd_hb_d_ren value = yes }
		}
		hd_hb_clear_effect = yes
	}
}

		hd_hb_spawn_effect = { ID = zhaojun_li_472 }

			set_global_variable = { name = hd_hb_p_zhaojun_li_472 value = this }

			hd_hb_try_marry_effect = yes
		}
		hd_hb_clear_effect = yes
	}
}

			set_global_variable = { name = hd_hb_p_henan_yan_013 value = this }
		}
		hd_hb_clear_effect = yes
	}
}
